## Summary

One or two plain sentences.

## Problem

What does not work today, and for whom?

## Rough approach

How might it be solved? Rough is fine. Mark what is undecided.

## Category

Core, Networking, Interface, Connection, Meta or Informational.

## Related

Links to protocol spec documents, other HIPs or earlier discussion.
